documents.title: Statement of Values, Ethics and Principles for Artificial Intelligence at UNM (draft)
documents.summary: Draft UNM AI Steering Committee statement (final draft July 23, 2026) setting three lenses (human-centered, trustworthy, sustainable) and community responsibilities. It sets principles rather than course rules.
documents.stance_why: The document is a draft statement of values meant to 'guide decisions about the development, procurement, deployment, governance, and use of AI' and sets no rule for student AI use; it points to 'course expectations', so the decision is delegated.
